Marta — thanks for the clear list. Summary / proposed approach below. I've attached a lightweight evidence matrix and a redline of the Order Form MSA clauses for review.

Proposed (high level):
- SOC 2: We publish annual SOC 2 Type II reports; we can provide a read-only copy plus an emailed attestation and a list of control owners. For routine evidence (config docs, runbooks), propose a sprinted handoff: 2-week evidence sprints during onboarding, then quarterly evidence bundles for the first year.
- Pen test: We prefer timeboxed, coordinated tests against a dedicated staging endpoint. Standard ask: 30 days notice, scope pre-approved by our security team, and tests run during a mutually agreed 72-hour window. We can provide a pen-test attestation if the customer prefers not to run active tests.
- Access model: Temporary, read-only shares to a secure drive for artifacts; scoped IAM accounts for deeper evidence requests during an agreed window (minimum 48 hours).

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx and the redlined MSA (MSA_redlines_v3.docx).
2) If OK, we'll propose an onboarding calendar with two 2-week evidence sprints and a final sign-off checkpoint.
3) I'll loop in our legal for any clause-specific negotiation.

Attachments: evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx; MSA_redlines_v3.docx; OrderForm_Medidocs_v2.pdf

Folks — quick legal read of the redlines and operational asks. We want to keep access controls and exposure limited while being cooperative. Key suggestions: 

- Audit rights: limit to one full customer-led audit per 12 months with incremental evidence requests handled via documented requests (not ad-hoc). This protects against unbounded inspection while meeting customer needs.
- Pen test clause: accept customer-initiated pen tests against a non-production environment only, with 30 days notice and pre-approved scope. Require a sanitised findings disclosure process (no public disclosure without remediation and mutual agreement).
- Evidence cadence: accept the proposed onboarding sprints, but change language to specify that artifacts are provided via secure share and that PII/log exports require an approved Data Access Request (DAR) with 7 business days lead time.
- Redline the indemnity/limitations: clarify that evidence sharing does not transfer responsibility for joint misconfiguration by the customer.

I added tracked changes in MSA_redlines_v3.docx. If Medidocs needs faster turnaround we can approve the onboarding schedule subject to an internal legal sign-off (24-48 hours).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
